_why: Host-resident disk GROWTH monitor (scripts/disk_monitor.py), complementary to the n8n band monitor (scripts/disk_usage_monitor.py, config/disk_hygiene_rules.json monitor block). The band monitor fires only at >=80% used and is gated behind the n8n relay; it has no baseline, so a store growing 63 MB/day (research_call_accounting) or a cache that doubles between polls is invisible until the band trips. This monitor measures df on the mount AND du of the known hotspots, compares each against a persisted baseline (per-path delta) and a rolling 24h window (growth rate), and alerts ONLY on a TRANSITION into warn/critical via telegram_alert (deduped by alert_condition_state). It NEVER deletes: it reports what the reviewed disk_hygiene rules would reclaim (from the latest manifest, or a quoted `disk_hygiene.py --dry-run` when --with-hygiene) and prints the operator-gated purge command. Changing this file is a reviewed PR; the purge targets themselves (worktrees/caches/logs/jsonl) live in config/disk_hygiene_rules.json, which is operator-only (§24.12).
